title: 邀请朋友参加小聚会
subtitle: Inviting a friend to a small party

audio.title: An invitation to a party
audio.note: 完整音频约 2分26秒；今天只听 0:00–1:00（第一条语音留言的前半段）。已核对页面音频可播放、时长及配套 transcript。先不要展开原文；完整 transcript 在来源页的 Transcript 标签中。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕听力｜先抓意思（4分钟）
sections.body:
打开音频，先只听 0:00–1:00，不看 Transcript。第一遍只判断场景；第二遍记下你听到的日期、地点或人物关系。不要逐词翻译，漏掉词也继续听。

听完后再做题；最后可到来源页展开完整 transcript 自查。第三方原文只提示一个短句：‘I'd love to see you there.’
questions: 说话人打电话的主要目的是什么？A. 道谢并邀请朋友参加生日聚会 B. 取消聚会 C. 询问工作情况
聚会大概是什么样的？A. 很大型的公开活动 B. 只有几位亲近朋友的小聚会 C. 公司会议
sections.answers:
1. A。她先感谢生日卡片和留言，然后邀请对方参加生日聚会。
2. B。她说聚会不大，只请几位最好、最亲近的朋友。

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
把 0:00–1:00 再听两遍，专抓下面三处。先听，暂停后模仿 2 次，再看提示；最后关掉文字重听整段。

① How's it going?｜How's it 常连成 /haʊzɪt/，不要拆成三个词。
② at work and you don't｜work_and 中间自然连起来；and 常弱读成 /ən/。
③ I'd love to see you there.｜I'd 是 I would 的缩写；love to 中的 to 常弱读 /tə/，see_you 会自然连读。

跟读顺序：先听一句 → 看提示模仿 → 关文本再听 → 用同样节奏说出整句。目标不是每个词都重读，而是突出 work、love、see、there 等信息词。
questions: 哪一个功能词在自然语流里常弱读成 /tə/？
把 ‘I would love to see you there’ 用缩写说一遍。
sections.answers:
1. to。
2. I'd love to see you there.

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜一次轻松的周五邀约（4分钟）
sections.body: Mia met Leo at work this week, and they quickly found out that they both enjoy cooking. On Thursday afternoon, Mia decided to invite him to a small dinner at her flat. She said, “Are you free on Friday evening? A few friends are coming over, and we’re making noodles together.” Leo liked the idea, but he needed to check one thing first. His sister was visiting the city, so he asked if she could come too. Mia smiled and said that she would be very welcome. They agreed to meet at seven. Mia sent Leo her address and told him not to bring anything. Leo still planned to buy some fruit on the way. He was a little nervous because he did not know the other guests, but Mia said, “Don’t worry. Everyone is friendly, and it’s just a relaxed evening.” After that, Leo felt much more comfortable.
questions: Why did Leo not accept immediately?
What made Leo feel more comfortable about the dinner?
sections.translation: 米娅这周在工作中认识了利奥，他们很快发现两个人都喜欢做饭。周四下午，米娅决定邀请他到自己的公寓参加一个小型晚餐。她说：“你周五晚上有空吗？几位朋友要来，我们会一起做面条。”利奥喜欢这个主意，但他需要先确认一件事。他的姐姐正在这座城市做客，所以他问姐姐是否也可以来。米娅笑着说，她会非常欢迎姐姐。两人约好七点见。米娅把地址发给利奥，并告诉他什么都不用带。利奥还是打算在路上买些水果。他有点紧张，因为不认识其他客人，但米娅说：“别担心。大家都很友好，这只是一个轻松的晚上。”听完以后，利奥安心多了。
sections.answers:
1. His sister was visiting the city, and he wanted to ask if she could come too.
2. Mia told him that everyone was friendly and the evening would be relaxed.

sections.title: 4. 高频词块｜发出和回应邀请（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Are you free on Friday?｜你周五有空吗？｜Are you free on Friday, or are you working? 你周五有空，还是要上班？
2. Would you like to come?｜你愿意来吗？｜Would you like to come to a small dinner? 你愿意来参加一个小型晚餐吗？
3. I'm having a few friends over.｜我要请几位朋友来家里。｜I'm having a few friends over on Saturday. 我周六要请几位朋友来家里。
4. That sounds great.｜听起来很棒。｜Dinner at your place? That sounds great. 在你家吃晚餐？听起来很棒。
5. Let me check.｜让我确认一下。｜Let me check my calendar and text you tonight. 让我看一下日历，今晚发消息给你。
6. What time should I come?｜我几点来合适？｜What time should I come, around seven? 我几点来合适，七点左右吗？
7. Can I bring anything?｜我需要带点什么吗？｜Can I bring anything for dinner? 晚餐我需要带点什么吗？
8. I'd love to.｜我很愿意。｜I'd love to. Thanks for inviting me. 我很愿意，谢谢你邀请我。
9. come over｜来家里做客｜Why don't you come over for coffee? 你何不过来喝咖啡？
sections.answers: 建议优先记住 7 个词块：Are you free ...? / Would you like to come? / I'm having a few friends over. / That sounds great. / Let me check. / Can I bring anything? / I'd love to.

sections.title: 5. 语法｜Would you like to + 动词？（3分钟）
sections.body:
用 Would you like to + 动词原形礼貌地邀请别人。肯定回答可用 I'd love to / That sounds great；如果暂时不能确定，可说 Let me check。

例句 1：Would you like to join us for dinner? 你愿意和我们一起吃晚餐吗？
例句 2：Would you like to come over on Sunday? 你愿意周日来我家吗？
questions: 填空：Would you like ___ (come) to my party?
把这句话改成礼貌邀请：Come to dinner with us on Friday.
sections.answers:
1. to come
2. Would you like to come to dinner with us on Friday?

sections.title: 6. 对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创对话
A: Are you free on Saturday evening?
B: I think so. Why?
A: I'm having a few friends over. Would you like to come?
B: I'd love to. What time should I come?
A: Around seven.
B: Great. Can I bring anything?
A: Just bring yourself!

替换练习
① Saturday evening → Sunday afternoon；a few friends → two classmates。
② come over → join us for coffee；around seven → at three。

快速回应：看到情景后，3 秒内开口。
1) 朋友邀请你周五吃饭，你愿意：I'd love to. What time should I come?
2) 你还不确定安排：That sounds great. Let me check and tell you tonight.
3) 你接受邀请并主动帮忙：Thanks! Can I bring anything?

30–60 秒口头任务：邀请一位新同事参加周末小聚。说明日期、时间、地点和活动，再给对方一种自然回应。先用词块组织意思，不要逐字翻译中文。
sections.answers: 示例：Hi, are you free on Saturday evening? I'm having a few friends over at my flat. We're making dinner together at seven. Would you like to come? You can say, ‘I'd love to. Can I bring anything?’

sections.title: 7. 复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个词块：
1. That sounds interesting.｜听起来很有意思。
2. I'm happy to help.｜我很乐意帮忙。
3. We could work together.｜我们可以一起合作。

快速串联：That sounds interesting. I'm happy to help, and we could work together.

请回原聊天告诉我：① 无字幕听懂了大约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成今天的邀请任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个今天的邀请词块，并用 30–60 秒完成一次邀请。
